### Enthralling Gaze { #awakening-enthralling-gaze }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/mero/enthralling_gaze.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Every enemy nearby that is looking at the user gets charmed and can't hurt her for a while. The charmed can still move, use their abilities and attack anyone else.

### Heart Rebound { #awakening-heart-rebound }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/mero/heart_rebound.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Throws a big heart that goes through everything in its way and comes back to the user, hitting each enemy it passes on the way there and back. On its way back it drags the enemies it strikes toward the user.
